_readme: Per-city overrides for the City life panel. Keys are city ids (lowercase, dashes). Each entry: { tags: [..], items: [{ icon, title, text }] }. Everything here is demonstration data and is shown with a demo badge. Do not name a venue or a date you have not checked — a closed club sends a student to a locked door.

items.title: Student clubs
items.text: Replace this with something you have actually checked, and add where you checked it.
